title: G's Dash
description: Driver display and car hub in nine looks (Simple, M Style, GT, Heritage, Flight, Digital '84, Sim Racing, Lumen, Pixel). Swipe between Showcase (the car, Spotify or a clock), Drive (opens first; shift lights, gear, rpm, speed, g-meter, drive mode badge, oil / coolant in °F or the fuel level), Warm-up (warm-up rev limit), G-force (peak hold) and Tires (TPMS). Optional Spotify panel (art, previous / play-pause / next, seek; own QR sign-in, Spotify Premium and mgu-uplink internet). Optional CarPlay map in the cluster: CarPlay's map on the instrument cluster through the separately installed Waze on cluster tool (off unless installed and turned on). Cluster source (0.8.3, Options > Cluster source, Auto by default): pick what the cluster's centre map area shows - Auto (as before), Logo (also while G's Dash runs in the background), Music (G's Music's lyrics / visualizer, the logo when nothing plays), Map (Waze on cluster's CarPlay map) or Stock (the car's own; Waze on cluster off); route guidance always shows directions, G's TV only after its own Cluster button; shared with G's Music and G's TV. Cluster logo (Auto): while open, the G's Dash logo in the cluster's centre map area unless route guidance runs (over Waze's map too; it steps aside only for the car's navigation, CarPlay or Android Auto route guidance, and for G's TV; with no route signal from the car it stays shown), through the separately installed Cluster renderer tool (on by default; nothing happens without the tool). Cluster skins (0.8.1: parked and driving): with the cluster in its Sport layout, the speedometer, tachometer, digital speed and gear redrawn live in the G's Dash look; fuel, oil, ACC / speed limit / assist graphics and telltales stay the car's own; stock again within a second if a signal is late or anything is wrong; and Options > Refresh cluster to remake G's Dash's cluster layers. HUD shift lights + gear (0.8.2, off by default): a thin band at the top of the HUD with shift lights in the look's style and the gearbox's gear (none in P or when unknown); turning it on turns the cluster skins off, and the other way Tested tools (0.8.4): Waze on cluster 0.6.3 or later (tested 0.7.1; shows its patch service starting / unavailable and why a build cannot be patched), Cluster renderer 0.2.2, GPU renderer 0.5.0 or later (current 0.6.8).

de.bmw.infotainment.drivingexcitement.FE._optional: the drive mode badge: statusFESVehicleDynamicSwitchHMI.actualValueModeDrivingExperience (enum ActualValueModeDrivingExperience2, by name or number); its pop-up request flags mark a change

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.TPMS._optional: the Tires screen: pressures, temperatures, targets, status (UInt16 raw: pressure x0.1 in the car's unit, temperature raw-40; read every 10 s; raw values logged and on the diagnostics page)

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.Vehicle._optional: the car's display units (air pressure, temperature) for the TPMS values

de.bmw.infotainment.lsc.LSCDataSink._optional: the fuel bar's level: fuelSupply.relativeFuelLevelEstimate (UInt16, read as %; as 0.1 % once a value above 100 arrives; raw values logged)

de.bmw.infotainment.KombiIF._optional: the fuel bar's range and reserve: statusRangeTankStatus.range (km), .statusFluidLevelFuelTankSpare (AKTIV = reserve), .fluidLevelFuelTank (litres, only without a %); no other member is read

de.bmw.powertrain.Range._optional: the fuel bar's range and low-fuel warning: dataRangeDisplay.dataRangeDisplayTotal in .unitRangeDisplay, .rangeWarningFuelLevel (GERING = low)

de.bmw.infotainment.navigation.navigatio._optional: the cluster logo's route guidance check: guidingState (INACTIVE / CALCULATING_ROUTE / ACTIVE; ACTIVE hides the logo); without it the logo goes by the phone's signals, and with none it stays shown

de.bmw.infotainment.a4a.carplay.CarPlayM._optional: the cluster logo's CarPlay route guidance check (Waze or Maps with a route): projectedGuidanceActive; without it the logo shows over Waze's map during a CarPlay route too

de.bmw.infotainment.sdi.aap.androidautop._optional: the cluster logo's Android Auto route guidance check: projectedGuidanceActive

startWidget.comment: Home-screen widget: just the G logo, large and centred (widget_logo.js from tools/make_g_icon.py: the mark alone, transparent, at 'size' and inside 'safe'). Same layout and cells as upstream's apps/edrive widget (BMW's Drive Recorder widget on this firmware): the picture goes into BackgroundImage1; every text line and the progress bar are written empty here once per placed widget. The small widget shows no pictures on this firmware (upstream's finding), so main.js sets its Title to the app's name; the big one's Title stays empty. 'safe' = share of width / height kept clear on each side (the HMI crops the edges).
